description: Figure 7, on the right, is a grouped bar chart that compares the CoLeG-R performance (%) of three LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four different training conditions. The horizontal axis lists the model scales, while the vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R score, ranging from 0 to 80%. For each model, four bars are shown, corresponding to the following conditions: "no SFT" (light blue with diagonal lines), "+ SFT on D₀" (light orange), "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" (light purple with diagonal lines), and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (light red). The results show that for all three models, the CoLeG-R score increases as the SFT dataset is scaled up from D₀ to D₀, D₁, D₂. Furthermore, for each SFT condition, the CoLeG-R score generally increases with the model scale, with the LLaMA-2-70B model achieving the highest scores across all conditions.
